hero.title: Your clothes in good hands
hero.lead: Shirts, suits, coats, wedding dresses, duvets: your city-centre dry cleaner cleans, removes stains and presses, with the price and the ready date given before you drop off.

tiles.lead: For each type of garment, the starting price and the usual turnaround. Full details are in the price list.

chemises.title: Shirts
chemises.text: Washed, pressed, returned on a hanger or folded. Blouses, jumpers and cardigans too.

costumes.title: Suits
costumes.text: Two or three-piece suits, jackets, trousers, ties: cleaned and pressed, ready to wear.

manteaux.title: Coats
manteaux.text: Wool, cashmere, down jackets, trench coats: cleaning that respects the fabric and the cut.

robes.title: Dresses & wedding dresses
robes.text: Everyday, evening and occasion dresses, and your wedding dress after the big day.

cuir.title: Leather & suede
cuir.text: Leather, suede or nubuck jackets and coats. Service to be confirmed in store.

linge.title: Household linen & duvets
linge.text: Duvets, blankets, throws, tablecloths, curtains: everything too big for your machine.

items.title: Stain removal

items.title: City centre
items.text: Rue des Jacobins, Monday to Saturday.

tarifs.title: The price and the time, before you drop off
tarifs.lead: Prices are “from” prices: the fabric, the lining or a particular stain can change the cost. If so, you are told at the counter, before any work starts.
promises: The price is confirmed at drop-off, nothing is added at collection.
Your ready date is written on your ticket.
For a delicate piece or a stain, a quote from a photo.
tarifs.note: Turnaround times are a guide, excluding Sundays and public holidays, and depend on how busy we are. Any price not shown is given at the counter or over the phone.

delicats.title: Wool, silk, cashmere: every fabric gets its own care
delicats.text: Before cleaning, we read the care label and check the fabric, the lining and the buttons. A suit comes back crease-free and ready to wear, a wool coat keeps its shape, a silk blouse is handled separately.

detachage.title: A stain? Send us a photo first
detachage.text: Wine, coffee, grease, make-up, ink: every stain is treated differently, depending on what it is, how old it is and the fabric. With a photo, we can tell you what can be done and at what price, before you make the trip.

mariee.title: After the big day, a clean dress, carefully put away
mariee.text: A train marked by the grass, a dusty hem, a few drops of champagne: a wedding dress needs careful cleaning, lace, embroidery and beads included. Describe it or send a photo and you get a quote before you hand it over.

reviews.title: Your feedback helps us improve
reviews.lead: We read every review. That is why prices and turnaround times are listed here, item by item, before you even walk in.

cta.title: A question about a garment?
cta.text: Send a photo or call us: you get a price and a turnaround time before making the trip.

infos.title: Visit us
infos.accessText: Right in Amiens city centre, on rue des Jacobins, a few steps from the Comédie de Picardie theatre. Paid parking on the street and nearby streets, city-centre car parks a few minutes’ walk away.
infos.mapTitle: Map to Teinturerie des Jacobins, 47 rue des Jacobins, Amiens

items.a: We are open Monday to Saturday, 9am to 7pm. You can drop off and collect without an appointment.

items.q: How long until my clothes are ready?
items.a: It depends on the item: usually 24 to 48 hours for a shirt, a few days for a coat or a duvet, and a quoted time for a wedding dress. The price list gives the turnaround for each item, and your ready date is written on your ticket.

items.q: How can I know the price before dropping off?
items.a: Starting prices are listed in the price table. For a particular piece or a stain, send 1 to 3 photos through the quote form, or come to the counter: you get the price before any work starts.

Most do, especially fresh ones. Some old stains or fragile fabrics will not give a perfect result: we tell you honestly beforehand. In the meantime, don’t rub or iron a stain, and bring the garment in as soon as you can.
You pay when you collect your clothes, in cash or by card.

items.q: Where can I park to drop off my clothes?
items.a: We are on rue des Jacobins, right in the city centre. There is paid parking on the street and nearby streets, and several city-centre car parks a few minutes’ walk away.
